# Brendon Oleghe (Maestro Brendon)

> Brendon Oleghe, known professionally as Maestro Brendon, is a senior brand and product designer with 7+ years leading design across fintech, Web3, e-commerce and real estate — 80+ brands built. He designs brand, product and motion as one system, then builds and ships it in Next.js, GSAP and Claude Code.

## Key pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://maestrobrendon.com/): Selected work, built-and-shipped live products, motion reel, archive, process and experience.
- [About](https://maestrobrendon.com/about): Career history (HEED/The Render Unit, Growmodo, The Matrix HQ, Quintes, LEDGA), education (University of Benin), and side ventures.

## Selected work

- [Vaultra Finance — Brand Identity](https://www.behance.net/gallery/244030983/Vaultra-Finance-Brand-Identity): A brand system for a finance platform that had to feel secure without feeling cold.
- [LEDGA — Full Branding](https://www.behance.net/gallery/209969707/LEDGA-Full-Branding-and-Identity-Design): An end-to-end identity and product UI for a digital banking platform.
- [Assura Cash](https://assuracash.com): A lending product site, designed and built to explain the offer in seconds.
- [Giftlyft — Brand Identity & Packaging](https://www.behance.net/gallery/244047577/Giftlyft-Brand-Identity-Packaging-Design): Brand identity and packaging for a gifting platform designed to feel joyful and giftable.

## Built and shipped

- [Assura Cash](https://assuracash.com), [Inaara Woman](https://inaarawoman.com), [Moods and Motion](https://moodsandmotion.vercel.app), [The Matrix HQ](https://thematrixhq.com), and this portfolio — all designed and built by Brendon.
